en-US.title: K Scan AI
en-US.subtitle: AI fashion discovery
en-US.description:
K Scan AI helps you turn photos of outfits and clothing into AI-assisted fashion analysis and retailer-neutral discovery.

Scan one or more images to explore garment and style details, organize your saved fashion items in a Cloud Closet, and restore supported Closet content across devices. Use Packing Intelligence to plan looks for trips and other occasions.

K+ is an optional auto-renewable subscription for premium features. Depending on feature and service availability, K+ experiences include Smart Watchlist, Voice Scan, AI Photo Virtual Try-On, and Live Camera Virtual Try-On for a supported pilot top on compatible devices. Live previews are illustrative and do not assess garment fit. Monthly and annual options are offered through Apple's in-app purchase system, with purchase restoration available in the app.

Sign in using Apple, Google, or email. Manage privacy preferences and request account deletion in the app.

K Scan AI is not a retailer or marketplace. It does not authenticate products or guarantee product availability, pricing, exact matches, or AI results.
en-US.releaseNotes: New in this update: multi-image fashion scanning, Cloud Closet sync and cross-device restore, Packing Intelligence, Smart Watchlist, Voice Scan, AI Photo Virtual Try-On, and Live Camera Virtual Try-On for a supported pilot top. K+ monthly and annual subscriptions are available through in-app purchase, with Restore Purchases and account privacy controls.
en-US.promoText: Scan a look and turn fashion inspiration into AI-assisted discovery.
